literal.prompt: Какой гормон одновременно усиливает высвобождение кальция из костной ткани и его реабсорбцию в почечных канальцах?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The exact question requires both bone calcium release and renal tubular calcium reabsorption. NLM MeSH Parathyroid Hormone L54 positively states both actions. The cortisol evidence links excess cortisol to osteoporosis, a pathological bone association, but does not establish this exact paired calcium-homeostatic action; osteoporosis alone is not equivalent to the pair. The question does not claim cortisol has no skeletal effect. Adrenaline and melatonin retain their independently sourced identities and notes.
literalGroups.locator: NLM MeSH Parathyroid Hormone L52-L54; Cushing Syndrome L52-L54; Adrenal Cortex Hormones L52-L54; Epinephrine L53-L55; Melatonin L52-L54.
